purpose: Pinned PS5 scene reference cache. Entries are engineering references, not implicit dependencies.

cache_policy.metadata: Always keep URL, exact commit, relevance and provenance in git.
cache_policy.source_snapshot: For cache_source=true, CI materializes an exact source snapshot including initialized submodules when licensing permits.
cache_policy.integration: Never import code automatically. Every reuse still requires license/provenance and delta review.

references.name: PS5 Vulkan
references.relevance: Primary live PS5 Vulkan/AGC reference: native VideoOut presentation, GFX1013 command work, Mesa/NIR/ACO integration, shader compilation cache, DXVK experiments and physical-console evidence.

references.name: AnyPS5
references.relevance: Very useful clean-room PS5 ABI and AGC reference. Current tree contains AGC command implementations, VideoOut modelling, persistent shader disk/pipeline cache work and x86 instruction relinking research. The 2026-10-01 refresh also preserves the comparison-image shader-cache fix and current AGC driver module split.

references.name: DualSenseClient
references.relevance: Protocol-level DualSense reference for USB/Bluetooth HID reports, adaptive-trigger blocks, haptics/audio transport and Edge fields. Useful to validate ps5rt input/output semantics even though it is a PC client.

references.name: EVO Player PS5
references.relevance: Hardware-tested native PS5 application reference: AudioOut/VideoOut, AGC work, FFmpeg cross-build, app-module/media-tile packaging and SDK/toolchain audits.

references.name: PS5PCEM
references.relevance: Useful PS5 guest-side reverse-engineering reference for AGC/PM4 streams, VideoOut/HLE exports, RDNA2 shader translation and memory/service behavior. Not a host runtime donor.

references.name: PS5 Payload SDK
references.relevance: Canonical public PS5 payload SDK/toolchain reference used by the project. Current checked pin adds LLVM 23 support.

references.name: PS5 Native App Boilerplate
references.relevance: Primary public native-title tooling reference: page-separated PIE layout, ELF conversion, FSELF/container tooling and packaging contracts.

references.name: PS5SX2
references.relevance: Primary live reference for a large x86-64 JIT emulator running natively on PS5. Metadata/pin cached; source snapshot is disabled until the aggregate license/vendor inventory is reviewed.

references.name: PS5 Dump Image Converter
references.relevance: Useful packaging/image-format reference for FFPKG, FFPFSC and exFAT handling. Not part of emulator runtime but relevant to distribution/storage tooling.

references.name: PlayStation Payload Center
references.relevance: Operational reference only. Proprietary binary-only license means we record metadata but do not mirror source/binaries into this project.

references.name: PS5 OpenGL
references.relevance: Hardware-validated PS5 OpenGL/Mesa/AGC reference with complete OpenGL 4.6 CTS evidence, showcase frame capture and recorded 1.0.0 frame-rate evidence; useful for GPU, tiling, shader, presentation and performance cross-checks even where Vulkan is the target renderer.

references.name: ProsperoEden
references.relevance: Native PS5 Eden-derived reference with pinned dependency builds; useful for Dynarmic, Vulkan/RADV and native application integration patterns.

references.name: PS5Link SDK
references.relevance: Alternative PS5 SDK/catalog reference with hardware-confirmed libc symbols and graphics examples; useful for ABI cross-checking without making it a primary SDK dependency.

references.name: SharpProspero
references.relevance: Independent PS5 SDK/tooling reference used to cross-check ELF/FSELF metadata, SDK coverage and packaging behavior.

references.name: PS5 AGC Gears
references.relevance: Small hardware-oriented AGC reference used by ps5-vulkan; valuable for command-buffer emission, suspend points, render targets and native presentation primitives.

references.name: OpenAGC PPSSPP PS5
references.relevance: Public PPSSPP PS5 port reference with Prospero build and controller/frontend work. Metadata is pinned now; snapshot remains disabled until aggregate upstream/vendor licensing is reviewed.

references.name: Historical PS5 RPCS3
references.relevance: Historical PS5 RPCS3 donor formerly used for PPU/SPU engine bring-up. Exact pin retained so any future mirror can be provenance-checked.

references.name: Historical PS5 LLVM
references.relevance: Historical LLVM fork with PS5 alignment fixes used by the old RPCS3 gate. Canonical LLVM now carries equivalent generic alignment contracts; exact old pin is retained for comparison.

references.name: Historical PS5 Mesa
references.relevance: Historical PS5 Mesa/RADV source pinned by the old graphics bundle. Exact revision remains recorded while the repository is unavailable.

references.name: Historical PS5 Vulkan
references.relevance: Historical PS5 Vulkan glue used by the frozen RADV bundle. Exact revision retained for future provenance recovery.

references.name: Historical PS5 PayloadSDK fork
references.relevance: Historical SDK fork paired with the frozen PS5 Mesa/Vulkan stack. Exact revision retained; active development uses ps5-payload-dev/sdk instead.

references.name: Historical PS5 Dynarmic
references.relevance: Historical PS5 Dynarmic donor for executable-code allocation. Exact revision retained while current integrations move to verifiable public upstreams.

references.name: Historical PS5 Mupen64Plus
references.relevance: Historical PS5 Mupen64Plus donor. Exact revision retained for provenance while CI preserves our transform contract independently.
